notes: A worked connector config for `python -m dskit.onboarding register-source webapi --connector restapi --config @examples/onboarding/source-restapi.json` (ADR-0017). The whole API shape is DECLARED here: swap base_url, the stream paths, and records_path for your API and nothing else changes. `records_path` is a dot-path to the record list inside each JSON response ({"data": {"rows": [...]}} -> "data.rows"); omit it when the body IS the list. Pagination is a closed vocabulary — this example chains cursor tokens found at meta.next_cursor back into the `cursor` query param; use {"strategy": "none"} for single-page endpoints, or the page/offset strategies for numbered pages. `secret` holds the NAME of the env var with the credential (export EXAMPLE_API_TOKEN=... before acquiring) — the material never enters this file, the store, or any hash; auth_format renders it into the auth_name header. `since_param` hands the stream's checkpoint cursor to the server so it can filter server-side; records are cursor-filtered client-side regardless, so an over-returning server is harmless.

prices.notes: One stream per endpoint; static query params ride on every request.
